title: 4815 Guernsey Street (House), Bellaire, Belmont County, OH
notes: Significance: Constructed in an area of residential structures in an elite section of the City of Bellaire. The house is significant for its eclectic architectural style, a well designed structure which exemplifies early twentieth century residential Ohio architecture. The size and distinctive design of the house is indicative of the once solid neighborhood in which it is situated.
